## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

- Closes https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/12439

## Additional information

(This PR will remain a draft while more tests are performed)

This PR introduces new methods to `AudioStreamPlaybackPolyphonic` that further improves flexibility, giving users more control of the streams. This allows for better custom audio systems.
Ideally, this should be merged along with https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/120761

Hack:
This PR introduces the option to pause streams. Since that's a bit of a more complex operation, what happens internally when the relevant method is called is that the current playback position is recorded, and the stream is stopped. The `Stream` is still active, and its `pause` property is set. When resumed, `start()` is called on the relevant stream playback with the recorded time, and `pause` is cleared.

Compatibility:
This PR breaks compatibility, by renaming `is_stream_playing` to `is_id_valid`. The method does the same thing, however, with the possibility of streams being paused, having both `is_stream_paused` and `is_stream_playing` wouldn't make sense. And all that the original method did was checking if a given ID is valid.
